newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH COOP BANKS SEE WEAKER H2,BETTER FULL-YR 97.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH COOP BANKS SEE WEAKER H2,BETTER FULL-YR 97.

text.p: The Finnish cooperative banking group said on Tuesday it expected weaker second-half earnings, but that full-year 1997 earnings would beat last year's 700 million markka net operating profit after credit losses.

"In the second half the performance is likely to be slightly weaker because somewhat more loan loasses are expected to accumulate than in the first half," the bank said in a statement with its January-June results.
"The full-year result is estimated to be significantly better than in 1996," it said.
